svg.title: MAXMotion position: the SPARK runs the profile
svg.desc: Animated diagram. At the top, your code on the roboRIO or SystemCore sets cruise velocity, max acceleration and an allowed profile error, then commands kMAXMotionPositionControl; a target tag drops down into the SPARK. Inside the SPARK: 1, a trapezoid toward the target, with a dot running along it and ticks lighting up as it is re-planned every 10 ms; 2, a 1 kHz PID, shown with an arrow circling fast, follows it and drives the motor, which turns. Below, the mechanism slides along a rail from start to the target flag. The SPARK can add kS, kV, kA (and kG/kCos for arms) itself; REV warns to retune PID from scratch when switching; in REVLib 2026 the only profile shape is trapezoidal.
svg.text: MAXMotion position: the SPARK runs the profile
REV's profile, run inside the SPARK: a trapezoid toward the target.
Your code, on the roboRIO or SystemCore
Set cruise velocity, max acceleration and an allowed profile error,
then command kMAXMotionPositionControl with the target.
The SPARK can add kS, kV, kA (and kG/kCos for arms) itself. REV warns:
retune PID from scratch when switching.
In REVLib 2026 the only profile shape is trapezoidal.
